title: Validation of anti-rug numeric settings

options.name: Keep current behaviour: empty LP_REMOVAL_PCT and CONFIRM_BLOCKS mean 0, GAS_MULTIPLIER has no ceiling, WATCHDOG_BUDGET_MS accepts a numeric prefix
options.risk: Ordinary .env mistakes silently change when and how hard the bot sells in an emergency (AUD-ANTIRUG-017).

options.name: Reject empty, 0 (where meaningless), above-ceiling and suffixed values at boot with a fatal error
options.behavior_impact: A bad value stops the bot at boot instead of changing behaviour.
options.risk: An existing .env with an empty line stops booting until fixed.

options.name: Treat empty as unset (use the default), cap the multiplier, parse durations strictly
options.behavior_impact: Empty values fall back to defaults; other bad values fail loud.
options.risk: An operator who meant 0 by an empty value gets the default.

recommendation: strict-fail-loud, matching how the other anti-rug keys already fail at boot.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract).
behavior_impact: Decides how a malformed anti-rug setting is handled.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
